name: task-board-default
description: Today's task-board behaviour (skill-project-management origin/main 4b0a75d6) written as a playbook: the PC1 acceptance target. Spec section 14 maps every element to the code and lists each accepted difference. The kernel has no transition table today: any status may be set when its gates pass, which from * reproduces.

orchestrator.description: Archetype analyst without lifecycle statuses (pkg/board/goal_role.go:25-33); the legacy name coordinator normalizes to it (goal_role.go:10-11).

developer.description: Archetype implementer; start development, end to-review (.roles/developer/role.md).

tester.description: Archetype tester; start development, end to-review (.roles/tester/role.md).

doc-writer.description: Archetype implementer; start development, end to-review.

researcher.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review.

solution-architect.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review.

context-builder.description: Archetype analyst; start analysis, end to-review.

reviewer.description: Archetype reviewer; start reviewing, verdict-driven end (goal_role.go:36-45; .roles/reviewer/role.md).

story.description: Parent must be an epic (types.go:209-218). Status aggregates from children (pkg/board/escalation.go:73).

review.description: Review policy; empty normalizes to required (types.go:106-133). No route of this permissive default selects on it; the ledger and the research landing read it (spec section 14, point 7).

estimates.name: points
estimates.description: set_estimate(scale=fibonacci); new records must be estimated before development (pkg/board/validation.go:60-68).

analysis.description: Start status of every analyst-archetype role, including project-defined ones (tools/board-cli/internal/spawn/role.go:303-335).

development.description: Start status of implementer and tester roles, including project-defined and legacy names (role.go:83-93).

to-review.description: Handoff reached; the orchestrator routes a reviewer.

integrating.description: Entered only through accept_cr (consistency.go:166-167). The orchestrator integrates the story; the leaf leaves through integration evidence, a restore, or a rollback to to-dev (consistency.go:169-172).

closed.description: Today closed carries no resolution value.

blocked.description: Linked blocked items release to backlog when every blocker is terminal (blocked_release.go:8-24, 76-87). Linkless ones are stop-the-line by convention; the kernel does not restrict who unblocks them today.

transitions.description: validation.go:46-58 (blockers), 60-68 (estimate; legacy records with no estimate and idempotent writes pass), 85-90 (assignee on manual moves).

A spawned run whose role ends in to-review must hand off its own element with the checklist complete and <ID>_results.md stored; reviewers (empty end status) and orchestrator-archetype runs (no lifecycle statuses) are not gated (tools/board-cli/cmd/producer_handoff_guard.go:71-78; pkg/board/handoff.go:122; errors.go:26-44; goal_role.go:25-33).
Inline review of work without a Change Request is admitted, as today (consistency.go:115-122).
Only an accepted immutable revision may enter integration (consistency.go:166-167).
The rejection command routes to to-dev (tools/board-cli/cmd/change_request.go:753, 825, 856); a manual move to to-dev stays possible through * -> to-dev.

Stop-The-Line: the reviewer parks its element at blocked with a new task-scoped evidence packet, and the goal ledger records stop_the_line; the revision stays as reviewed (tools/board-cli/internal/spawnruntime/goal_acceptance.go:51-96, 255-256; changerequest.go:403-405). Shadows * -> blocked for this pair; people and the orchestrator still park elements freely.
IntegrationAuthorized (consistency.go:169-172); every status change also passes the blockers check (consistency.go:176; validation.go:46-58).
Inline done route: refused while a Change Request exists (consistency.go:128-141, 158); commit acknowledgement for the enforced types when the policy confirms (version_control.go:89-123).
A leaf closes from any lifecycle state (validation.go:31-33).
Automatic release of linked blocked items (blocked_release.go:8-24, 87).

container.description: Epics and stories. Status aggregates from children (escalation.go:73, 140): aggregation reopens done and closed containers when a child becomes active (escalation.go:151-162, 198-200) and moves them into and out of integrating (escalation.go:65-68). Aggregated moves are not transitions (spec section 5.1): they ignore terminal, locked and declared guards but obey the blockers check, so a container with active blockers is not aggregated forward (escalation.go:163-172; validation.go:46-58), and a blocked container is left alone (escalation.go:151). Direct statuses are admitted too; only the close is gated (validation.go:34-43).

integrating.description: Reached and left by aggregation only.

transitions.description: The done check applies to every element (consistency.go:158); story is a version-control enforced type (version_control.go:18-19, 277-279).
A container closes only after every descendant is done or closed (validation.go:34-43).
blocked_release.go:76-87 applies to any blocked element with links.
